text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Assets of Bahrain's offshore banking units stood at $67.1 billion at end-September this year, up nine percent from end-June, Bahrain Monetary Agency says.
- Jordanian parliament approves 1997 budget with a 225 million dinar deficit.
- Saudi, British and German companies plan to build a 225 million riyal petrochemical plant in Yanbu.
- Bahrain's Emir pardons two Qataris accused of spying for Qatar after a State Security Court found them guilty and sentenced them to three years in jail.
- Bahrain's electricity minister inaugurates expansion of four power substations at a cost of 26 million dinars.
